newsitem.title: USA: Western Atlas names spin-off UNOVA.
newsitem.headline: Western Atlas names spin-off UNOVA.

text.p: Western Atlas Inc Friday said it chose the name UNOVA Inc for the new industrial technolgy company it plans to spin off from its current business.

In May, Western Atlas, said it would break into two companies with its oilfield service businesses continuing to use the Western Atlas name. It will be based in Houston, and will generate revenues of about $1.6 billion annually.
The industrial technologies businesses, to be called UNOVA, will be based at current headquarters in Beverly Hills. It will have annual revenues of about $1.5 billion.
The name UNOVA describes the new company's objective to provide innovative solutions for customer productivity on a universal basis, Western Atlas said.

All shares of UNOVA are scheduled to be distributed to holders of Western Atlas Inc common stock on a one-for-one basis. The transaction is expected to be tax-free to the corporation and its shareholders and should be completed in the fall of 1997. The shares are planned to be listed on the New York Stock Exchange.
